artifact.summary: Builds an n-qubit diagonal Hermitian gate D=diag((-1)^f(x)) from a truth table f. The circuit computes the GF(2) algebraic normal form of f with the fast binary Moebius transform. It then applies one multi-controlled Z gate (Z, CZ, or H-MCX-H) per nonempty subset S with c_S=1, on data qubits only. A constant ANF term becomes a global phase of pi. There are no ancillas, measurements, or state preparation.
register_layout: Qubit i (Qiskit index i, i=0..n-1) holds bit x_i of the computational basis index x; index 0 is least significant.
Single register q of n data qubits, no ancillas.
truth_table[x] = f(x) with x = sum_i x_i 2^i; D|x> = (-1)^f(x)|x>.

equation_mapping.explanation: The gate is specified directly by its sign function f as a 0/1 truth table; non-binary entries are rejected with ValueError.

equation_mapping.code_location: build_circuit: final loop applying z/cz/h-mcx-h on qubits of S
equation_mapping.explanation: MCZ_S applies the phase (-1)^(prod x_i over S) via Z, CZ, or H-MCX-H on the last qubit of S.

equation_mapping.code_location: build_circuit: Moebius transform result b[S] used as c_S; global_phase for b[0]
equation_mapping.explanation: The ANF coefficients c_S are the expansion of the binary representation in the MCZ basis. The constant term is mapped to global_phase=pi when it is 1.

equation_mapping.code_location: build_circuit: nested loops over i and x (Moebius butterfly)
equation_mapping.explanation: For each bit i and each x with bit i set, b[x] ^= b[x without bit i], giving c_S = xor of f(x) over x subset of S.

equation_mapping.code_location: build_circuit: loop over s in 1..2^n-1 with b[s]==1
equation_mapping.explanation: The circuit is the product of the commuting MCZ_S gates over the support of c, with global phase (-1)^c_empty.

specification_changes.change: The constant ANF term c_empty is kept as an exact circuit global_phase of pi instead of being dropped.
specification_changes.reason: This makes the circuit equal to D exactly, not only up to global phase; it costs no gates.

specification_changes.change: The instance is generalized from the tiny n=3 case to any n in 1..12, with the truth table supplied in the instance.
specification_changes.reason: Required to support varying valid instance parameters, under the 12-qubit cap.

specification_changes.change: Gray-code ordering, gate sharing, CZ-based decomposition of large MCZ gates, and cost comparison are not implemented. MCZ with |S|>=3 uses H-MCX-H.
specification_changes.reason: These are outside the stated reconstruction scope.

assumptions: Instance keys are n and truth_table; truth_table[x]=f(x) with x little-endian.
Order of MCZ gates is irrelevant because they are all diagonal and commute.
Gate decomposition of MCX is left to Qiskit's standard mcx.
unresolved_issues: The paper's exact binary representation convention and its gate ordering/sharing optimization are not reconstructed.
How the paper decomposes MCZ gates with |S|>=3 into CZ gates is unknown.

validation.detail: Circuit built and transpiled successfully; no independent correctness reference selected.
